name: Advance 02 — Keep Smiling
subject: Keep smiling, SIRI 💫
heading: A SMILE THAT BRIGHTENS THE WORLD
message: There is something truly remarkable about a genuine smile. It softens the world, makes ordinary afternoons memorable, and brings warmth to everyone around. Today, as your special day approaches, this is just a gentle reminder to keep that beautiful smile glowing. May life always be kind to you, and may you never run out of reasons to laugh, to hope, and to celebrate the person you are, {NAME}.
